acceptanceCriteria: ticket show and ticket blockers report the effective required gate set, including policy-mandated gates, matching what complete enforces
A regression test with a ticket whose own requiredGates omit a policy-mandated gate shows that gate in both read outputs and in complete's MISSING_GATE refusal
body: Observed 2026-10-20 with corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.676: ticket show and ticket blockers for V1-0254 report requiredGates ["full-gate"] and for V1-1114 report []. After a passing full-gate (about 2.5 h), complete refused MISSING_GATE with 'gate focused-docs has no result' for all eight tickets. A closeout driven by the reported requiredGates therefore fails at the last step; when the caller then releases, the passing gate result is stranded on a cancelled attempt (V1-0253, 2026-10-20). Expected: the read surfaces report the effective gate set (ticket gates plus policy-mandated gates) that complete will enforce, or complete names the policy source. Related but distinct: V1-1874 (approval grants revealed one at a time).
